# Image Pipeline

This WIPI-C example exercises offscreen framebuffers, context mutation, RGB pixel upload and readback, framebuffer copying, image decoding, image drawing, and repaint presentation. Its embedded 1 by 1 GIF is an original synthetic fixture and contains no commercial asset.

- {download}`Application source <../../../examples/image-pipeline/main.c>`
